messages:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy fanout to PROD (change window 12:00-13:00 UTC). Rollout rfd-20260311-11. Targets:
- runtime -> v2.4.1 (commit abc1234)
- api -> v1.9.0 (commit def5678)
- console -> v3.0.0 (commit ghi9012)
Canary rules: runtime 5% -> 30% over 5m, api 5% steady, console staged migration on 10%

mike: On it. I'll keep release-notes updated and coordinate rollback sign-off if needed. :white_check_mark:

sasha: I'll monitor runtime p95/p99, KV cache hit/miss, and memory footprint.

deploy-bot: runtime canary started at 12:01 UTC. initial p95=210ms, kv_hit=93%.

amanda: API canary started. seeing a handful of 502s at 12:03 UTC, investigating gateway traces.

rachel: Kicking off console migration step 1 -> step 2 now. Watching for schema locks.

deploy-bot: At 12:05 UTC: runtime ramp to 20% (stable). api at 5%. console migration proceeding.

amanda: API 502s spike persists around 12:06-12:07. Gateway logs show upstream resets. snippet: ```gateway -> upstream reset by peer (api-service) 12:06:45```

sasha: After pushing runtime to 30% at 12:07, p95 jumped to ~610ms and kv_evictions spiked. Looks like new model weights cause cache churn.

rachel: Migration step 2 failed on ~4% of console instances: ```ERROR: acquire migration lock timeout
stack: migration.apply -> lock.wait (attempt 4)``` Rolling console back.

leo: Consensus check: api 502s + runtime perf regression + console migration failures = abort remainder and restore LKG. Approve? :warning:

mike: Approve. Initiating rollbacks/pinning. Pinning plan: runtime -> v2.4.0 (pin commit a9b8c7d), api rollback -> v1.8.9 (commit c3b2a1f), console rollback started.

deploy-bot: Actions executed:
- api: rollback to v1.8.9 (commit c3b2a1f) -> deployed to 100% nodes at 12:12 UTC
- runtime: halted rollout; pinned to v2.4.0 (commit a9b8c7d); traffic routed back
- console: migration aborted; rollback triggered -> 95% nodes reverted by 12:14 UTC
Links: runbook https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-fanout, logs https://internal.redwood/logs/rfd-20260311-11

amanda: API looks healthy post-rollback, 502s returned to baseline within 3m. Will open follow-up to tune DB pool and connection handling.

sasha: Runtime metrics normalized after pin. I'll prepare a canary warmup (KV prefill) before the next attempt and add metric alerts for kv_evictions.

rachel: Console rollback complete. I'll reproduce migration in staging with lock diagnostics and file a migration postmortem.

mike: Updating release notes and blocking next production change window until action items are closed. Creating incident doc and scheduling a short retro.

leo: Thanks folks. Owners: please add action items to the incident doc (migration lock root cause, api DB pool, runtime cache warmup). Tagging infra and db teams for follow-up.

mike: :thumbsup: Closing this thread. Follow-ups tracked in #postmortems and the incident doc above.
